```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
load("dane/imiona_df.Rda")
```

```{r}
imiona <- imiona_df
imiona
```

```{r}
meskie <- unique(filter(imiona, plec == "M")$imie)
zenskie <- unique(filter(imiona, plec == "K")$imie)
```

```{r}
meskie[str_starts(meskie, "B")]
```

```{r}
# $ - od końca
# ^ - od początku
# [] - zbiór znaków
# [^] - negacja zbioru

str_subset(meskie, pattern = "a$")
str_subset(zenskie, pattern = "a$", negate = TRUE)
str_subset(zenskie, pattern = "[^a]$")
str_subset(meskie, pattern = "^S[^aeiouy]")
```

```{r}
# table - zlicza wystąpienia
barplot(table(str_sub(zenskie, start = 1, end = 1)), col = "pink")
```

```{r}
barplot(table(str_sub(meskie, start = 1, end = 1)), col = "navy")
```

```{r}
barplot(table(str_sub(meskie, start = -1, end = -1)), col = "black")
```
